basics.label: Revenue Cycle Manager | Multi-Specialty RCM | Denials | A/R | Remote Operations
basics.summary: Revenue Cycle Manager with 12+ years across U.S. medical billing, charge and claim workflows, payment posting, denials and appeals, A/R, credentialing, payer operations, analytics, and remote-team leadership. Oversees high-volume multi-specialty delivery, establishes KPIs and accountability, investigates revenue leakage, improves workflows and SOPs, aligns staffing to workload, and translates operational data into clear executive action.

skills.name: Revenue Cycle Management and Team Leadership
